text: Ɓen ɓe Malaa'ikaajo waroowo on e wallondirooɓe makko ɓen ƴettitata -hara ko ɓe laaɓuɓe ɓerɗe mun e keeferaaku- Malaa'ikaaɓe ɓen wi'ana ɓe: Salaamun ‘alaykum (kisiyee wonii e mon), on hisii e kala geddi. Naatiree Alajanna on sabu ko golli-raynoɗon kon ka aduna, immorde e fiɓnde sellunde e golle moƴƴe.
